BETA Close X Sage Group PLC has completed its share buyback program, repurchasing a total of 34,809,318 ordinary shares for an aggregate consideration of £299,999,994.16, at an average price of £8.6184 per share. The company announced the purchase of an additional 626,610 ordinary shares on 28 May 2026, with prices ranging from 834.4000 to 858.6000 pence per share, and a volume-weighted average price of 846.1980 pence per share. All purchased shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 28 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026. Ordinary Shares Date of purchase: 28 May 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 626,610 Highest price paid per share: 858.6000 Lowest price paid per share: 834.4000 Volume weighted average price paid per share: 846.1980 Sage will cancel all the purchased shares. Sage confirms that the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 has now been completed. A total number of 34,809,318 ordinary shares in Sage were repurchased as part of the share buyback programme and Sage will cancel all the purchased shares. The aggregate amount of the consideration paid by Sage was £299,999,994.16 and the average price paid per ordinary share was £8.6184.
